finalText:
**Big but bounded: 1082 hits in 94 files.** Three zones must not be renamed.

| Zone | Files | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `services/**` internals | 75 | 1200 lines* | Safe to rename |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | 61 | Frozen. Already applied in prod |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` + `lib/serialize.js` | 2 | 6 | Frozen. Public API contract |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | 20 | Frozen. Overwritten by `vendor:refresh` |

*Of the service hits, 125 sit inside SQL strings in `repo/` files. Those name the real DB column. They only change if a new migration renames the column.

`lib/serialize.js:8` is the wall. `account_id` must stay on the right side of `WIRE`.

Sign-off is fine if the diff touches `services/**` only, minus repo SQL. Ask them for the migration plan before agreeing to the column.
